name: How long does siding repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does siding repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of siding repair depends largely on the scope of the project. Small, isolated repairs, such as replacing a few damaged boards, might be completed in a single day. More extensive damage, involving multiple sections or underlying structural issues, could take several days to a week. Your contractor will provide an estimated timeline after assessing the damage.
